# Coffee Circle

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

German online coffee roaster shop selling beans, ground coffee, capsules and brewing equipment such as grinders, kettles, scales and espresso machines. Its shipping page lists delivery to Germany and about 30 other European destinations, shipped with DHL.
